body:
Photographs from EXCHANGE’s participation in the International Economic Fair Mostar 2022, bringing together project partners to promote aquatic biodiversity, regional cooperation and sustainable tourism.

The fair provided an opportunity to present Blue Pass and launch its digital guide for Android and iOS. The guide connects natural and cultural heritage with thematic visitor routes across Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Montenegro, while the Blue Pass ticket offers discounted visits to participating attractions.

I joined colleagues and project partners at the exhibition stand to present this shared tourism offer. The gallery captures the people behind the initiative, exchanges at the stand and the Blue Pass ticket linking the project’s destinations.

Read more about EXCHANGE at the fair.
